_comment: Golden ProviderItemEnvelope for Google Drive (#523): one screened document fetched from the folder named by the descriptor's resource_id.
_expected_behavior: accepted — describes a fetched Google Drive document without governance, review, or binding authority
_authority_boundary: Provisional alpha provider-fact handoff object. It is NOT Source, SourceSnapshot, SourceEvidence, DecisionCandidate, Decision, ToolRequest, ExternalIngestEnvelope, or event-store authority. content and provider_metadata are screened, non-secret provider facts only.
title: Graph snapshot service — runtime architecture
content: The snapshot service materializes a content-addressed code state anchored by commit SHA. Readiness is reported as a typed currentness outcome.
